akame: Tatsumi leaves his village hoping to support its people and becomes involved with a group fighting a corrupt empire. His new allies force him to confront the dangers and moral costs of rebellion.
assassination-2: Class 3-E returns to school with its unusual mission still unfinished: assassinate the teacher who is helping its students succeed. New rivals and personal challenges test the class as its deadline approaches.
danganronpa: Makoto enters an elite academy only to discover that its students are trapped in a deadly game. Escaping requires a murder, and uncovering the culprit becomes a matter of survival.
demon-slayer: After demons attack his family, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps. He searches for a way to restore his sister Nezuko's humanity while facing increasingly dangerous opponents.
haikyuu-3: Karasuno faces powerhouse Shiratorizawa in the match that will decide its place at nationals. Hinata and his teammates must bring together everything they have learned against an imposing opponent.
hunter: Gon takes the dangerous Hunter Examination in the hope of following his father's path. The friends he makes along the way draw him into a world of challenging adventures and extraordinary abilities.
promised-neverland: Life at Grace Field House seems peaceful for its young residents. When its oldest children uncover a disturbing secret, they must question everything they believed about their home.
tokyo-ghoul: A disastrous encounter changes student Ken Kaneki into a human-ghoul hybrid. He struggles to preserve his identity while learning to survive between two hostile worlds.
arrietty: Tiny Arrietty lives beneath a house, borrowing small necessities from its human occupants. Her friendship with a visiting boy puts her family's carefully hidden way of life at risk.
weathering: Runaway Hodaka arrives in a rain-soaked Tokyo and meets Hina, a girl who can bring sunshine. Their attempt to make a living with her gift reveals that changing the weather has consequences.
spirited-away: Chihiro wanders into a mysterious spirit world and must work in a bathhouse to survive. With unexpected allies, she searches for a way to rescue her parents and return home.
one-piece: Monkey D. Luffy sets sail in pursuit of the legendary One Piece treasure. He gathers an unusual crew and faces dangerous seas, powerful rivals, and new adventures on the way to becoming Pirate King.
charlotte: Yuu uses a brief possession ability to get ahead at school until another student exposes him. Joining a school for young ability users brings responsibilities and mysteries he never expected.
hello-world: A reserved student in futuristic Kyoto meets a man claiming to be his older self. The stranger urges him to change a tragedy involving a classmate, setting a complicated plan in motion.
your-name: A countryside girl and a Tokyo boy begin waking up in each other's bodies. Their attempts to understand the experience draw their lives together across distance and unexpected circumstances.
angels-of-death: Rachel awakens inside a strange building with no memory of how she arrived. An uneasy alliance with a dangerous man becomes her only way through its threatening floors.
classroom-elite: A prestigious school divides students into classes with unequal privileges. Ayanokoji and his classmates must navigate its ruthless competition to improve their standing.
kiki: Young witch Kiki leaves home for a year of independent living with her cat Jiji. Starting a broomstick delivery service helps her discover responsibility, friendship, and her place in a new town.
totoro: Two sisters move to the countryside while their mother receives hospital treatment. Discovering a gentle forest spirit brings wonder and comfort into their new daily lives.
noragami: Minor god Yato takes odd jobs while dreaming of a devoted following. An accident connects him with Hiyori, whose unusual condition draws her into his supernatural world.
another: A transfer student finds his classmates behaving strangely toward a quiet girl with an eyepatch. A series of unsettling events leads him to investigate the secret surrounding their class.
death-parade: A mysterious bar receives people after death and tests them through revealing games. Its arbiter begins to question his judgments when an unfamiliar visitor changes his perspective.
mugen-train: Tanjiro and his companions join Flame Hashira Rengoku to investigate disappearances aboard a train. A hidden demonic threat puts the passengers and their rescuers in danger.
erased: Satoru's ability to revisit moments before disaster sends him back to his childhood. He tries to prevent a classmate's disappearance while unraveling a mystery connected to the present.
haikyuu: Determined volleyball player Hinata joins Karasuno and discovers that his former rival Kageyama is now his teammate. Learning to work together becomes essential to rebuilding their team's reputation.
haikyuu-2: Karasuno prepares for the next tournament by training alongside formidable rival teams. Hinata, Kageyama, and their teammates work to strengthen their skills and develop new approaches.
haikyuu-top: With nationals ahead, Karasuno's players face new training opportunities and personal challenges. Hinata looks for his own way to improve while his teammates refine their abilities.
haikyuu-top-2: Karasuno's national tournament journey continues against increasingly demanding opponents. The team must adapt under pressure to keep its ambitions alive.
jujutsu-kaisen: Yuji Itadori is drawn into a hidden world of curses and sorcerers. Training alongside other students, he faces supernatural threats while carrying a dangerous power within him.
iruma: Iruma is sold to a demon who unexpectedly adopts him as a grandson. Attending a demon school means navigating strange traditions while hiding the fact that he is human.
iruma-2: Iruma grows more comfortable at demon school and begins pursuing a higher rank. New responsibilities in the student council bring unusual challenges and unexpected trouble.
assassination: An overlooked class receives an extraordinary assignment: kill its nearly unstoppable new teacher before he destroys Earth. His dedication to teaching complicates the students' unusual mission.
entertainment-district: Tanjiro's group accompanies Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui into the entertainment district. A search for missing allies leads them toward a dangerous demon hiding among its bustling streets.
iruma-3: Iruma and his classmates must improve their ranks to keep their special classroom. New tutors and demanding school festivals give them a chance to prove their progress.
tangerines: On Jeju Island, a spirited young woman and a dependable young man build a life together. Their story follows love, family, and perseverance across the challenges of passing years.
while-sleeping: A woman dreams of future accidents, and a prosecutor becomes involved in trying to prevent them. Their shared efforts raise questions about whether tragedy can truly be changed.
graceful-family: An heiress and a lawyer investigate the truth behind her mother's death. Their work brings them into conflict with the secrets protecting a powerful family.
attorney-woo: Young attorney Woo Young-woo brings exceptional legal insight to her first professional cases. Alongside courtroom challenges, she navigates relationships and the expectations of her workplace.
mr-queen: A modern man's soul unexpectedly becomes trapped in the body of a Joseon-era queen. Adjusting to palace life means facing unfamiliar customs, royal intrigue, and an unusual identity crisis.
dear-x: Successful actress Baek Ah-jin hides a manipulative personality behind her polished public image. The relationships and sacrifices behind her rise reveal a darker side of fame.
alice-borderland: A gamer and his friends find themselves in a deserted version of Tokyo. Surviving its dangerous games forces them to use their wits and question the rules of their new reality.
unwritten-seoul: Twin sisters with very different lives exchange identities after an unexpected turn of events. Each must face unfamiliar responsibilities while discovering what she truly wants.
perfect-crown: A wealthy heiress lacks the status that society values, while a prince has status without freedom. A contract marriage offers both a way to challenge the expectations shaping their lives.
hells-kitchen-vegas: Aspiring chefs compete in a demanding Las Vegas kitchen for a major career opportunity. Team challenges and intense dinner services test their skill, discipline, and ability to handle pressure.
hells-kitchen-ages: Chefs from different age groups compete through culinary challenges and high-pressure dinner services. Their contrasting experience and approaches become part of the battle for a life-changing prize.
enola-holmes: Sherlock Holmes's younger sister sets out to find her missing mother. Her journey to London intersects with a runaway young nobleman and a mystery larger than she expected.
enola-holmes-2: Enola returns for another detective adventure alongside her famous brother. Seeking to establish herself independently, she becomes involved in a new mystery.
witch: A young woman with an unusual past becomes entangled in the consequences of experiments on human abilities. Her connection to a dangerous organization threatens the life she has built.
ready-or-not: A bride's wedding-night introduction to her husband's wealthy family becomes a deadly ritual. She must survive their twisted tradition before the night is over.
infinity-castle: The Demon Slayer Corps enters Muzan's shifting fortress for a confrontation with its most dangerous enemies. The battle brings its members face to face with the remaining Upper Rank demons.
weightlifting: A young weightlifter navigates training, friendship, and first love alongside fellow student athletes. Their ambitions and everyday struggles shape a warm coming-of-age story.
ready-or-not-2: Grace is pulled into another deadly ritual immediately after her first ordeal. This time, protecting her estranged sister means surviving the pursuit of several powerful families.
